requirements.en: Validate international orders and maintain accurate line-level availability records.
requirements.zh: 核验国际订单，并维护准确的订单行级供货记录。

requirements.en: Communicate routine order updates in written English and preserve a clear correspondence trail.
requirements.zh: 以书面英语沟通日常订单更新，并保留清晰往来通信记录。

requirements.en: Coordinate logistics information and escalate pricing or document exceptions to the responsible team.
requirements.zh: 协调物流信息，并将价格或单证异常升级交给责任团队。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently prepare customs declarations and resolve tariff classifications.
requirements.zh: 优先：独立编制报关单并解决关税归类问题。
